text:
alex_hoa: Heads-up — planning a breaking change to the Partner SDK auth format (token -> signed header). This touches marketplace connectors, SI integrations, and hardware edge SDKs. Proposed cadence: canary next week, full deprecation 60 days after announce. Need partner coordination and a clear migration playbook.

maria_g: What's the motivation? is this backwards-compatible at all?

alex_hoa: The signed header improves replay protection and lets edge devices avoid long-lived bearer tokens. Not backwards-compatible without a shim.

chris_devex: We can ship a compatibility shim that accepts old bearer tokens for one release, but recommend forcing migration to v3.0.0 semantics. Will need docs + code samples + CI tests.

maria_g: Agree on a shim short-term. Also we should add matrix tests (node/python/go) to our partner CI so partners see failures earlier. I can extend the test harness.

tanya_partnerops: I'll start partner outreach. Suggest two tracks: 1) Marketplace partners (auto-updates) with a 60-day window, 2) Enterprise/SI/hardware partners with a 90-day window and scheduled webinars.

evan_infra: For hardware partners we need to validate signature perf on low-power ARM boards and on 40xx-class GPUs (some kernels may need tuning). I'll provision test nodes and run perf delta. ETA 5 days.

partner-integrations-bot: Canary job created: partners/canary-auth-check (scheduled 2026-03-27T02:00Z). Status: queued.

alex_hoa: Checklist I'm putting together:
- migration script (owner: alex_hoa)
- docs & samples (owner: chris_devex)
- compatibility shim (short-lived)
- CI matrix updates (owner: maria_g)
- partner comms + webinar (owner: tanya_partnerops)
- hardware impact matrix (owner: evan_infra)
- public announcement & release notes (PM + marketing)

chris_devex: I'll draft the migration guide and samples. Initial snippet below for quick copy into partner SDKs:

```python
# v2 auth
headers = {'Authorization': f'Bearer {TOKEN}'}

# v3 auth (signed header)
headers = {'X-Redwood-Signed': sign_payload(TOKEN)}
```

Also add: run `pytest tests/compat/*` locally against the canary endpoint.

tanya_partnerops: For communications: I'll prepare a partner-facing FAQ, a migration checklist, and a 30-min technical webinar. Recommend freeze of marketplace rolling updates for 48h around the rollout.

maria_g: I'll add automated compatibility jobs to CI that run nightly against the canary host and post results to #partner-ci. Also add an opt-in webhook for partners to test their SDKs automatically.

alex_hoa: Deprecation windows proposal: announce -> 30-day beta (opt-in canary) -> 60 days marketplace cutoff, 90 days enterprise/hardware cutoff. Shim available for 1 minor release after cutoff only. Does that work?

evan_infra: Hardware partners will want firmware lead time and sign-off. I'll create an impact matrix and reach out to the embedded partner list today. Will highlight any required driver/kernel changes.

partner-integrations-bot: Reminder: please create Jira epic `SDK-V3-COMPAT` and link partner tickets. Suggested ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SDKV3-1

chris_devex: :thumbsup: I'll start the doc PR and include migration code for node/python/go.

maria_g: Working on CI changes now, will open MR by EOD.

tanya_partnerops: I'll draft the email + schedule webinar invites. Asking PM/marketing to review announcement copy.

alex_hoa: Thanks — I'll post this summary to #partners and schedule a short sync next Tue 10:30 PT. If anything blocks owners, call it out here.

chris_devex: on it.

maria_g: noted, will post CI logs when available.

tanya_partnerops: assembling partner list + outreach plan.

evan_infra: starting hardware matrix, will share by Friday.

alex_hoa: Great. Keeping this thread as the single source for partner compatibility coordination. We'll add linked JIRA and doc PRs as they land.
